description: 775519 was a T-6 shuttle used by Jedi Master Sifo-Dyas prior to the outbreak of the Clone Wars. It was shot down over the desert moon of Oba Diah, killing Sifo-Dyas, and its remains were later discovered by the troopers of Wolfpack c. 20 BBY.

data.destroyed: 32 BBY, desert moon of Oba Diah
